Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 12 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Aditi - 8 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Neeta - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The snowy hillside - Day

[Aarav stands in the snow. Neeta and Aditi stand near him.]

Neeta: "Aditi, what's the plan today?"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Aarav: "Really?"

[Aarav catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Aarav (surprised): "Okay, Aditi."

[Aarav slides down the snowy slope.]

Aditi: "That was fun!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Aarav stands in the park. Aditi and Neeta stand near him.]

Neeta: "What a nice place."

[Aarav throws the ball to Mother.]

Aarav (excited): "I'm ready!"

[Aarav plays cricket in the park.]

Aditi: "That's easy."

[Aarav swings on the swing.]

Aditi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditi skips rope.]

Aditi (laughing): "Mom, look at this."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Neeta: "Aarav, look over here."

[Aarav waves goodbye to Mother.]

Neeta: "Listen!"

[Aarav takes the bag from Mother.]

Neeta: "Aarav, are you okay?"

[Aarav coughs.]

Aarav: "Yes, all right."

[Aarav lights a bonfire.]

Aarav: "That was fun!"

[Aarav milks the cow.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Aarav: "Mom, look at this."

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Aarav: "And then?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Aarav: "Mom, listen!"

[Suddenly the ground shakes.]

Aarav: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Aarav (softly): "What happened?"

[Aarav lights a bonfire.]

Aarav: "What a day to remember!"
